title: CRITICAL: real Flash 8 FLA import — extract actual document content (0107 was a stub)
description:
Audit finding: task 0107 'real FLA import' is marked done but packages/core/src/fla/ole.ts parseFlash8Stream() only pattern-scans for stage dimensions/fps/background color and returns a SKELETON document (one empty layer) — no shapes, no symbols, no timelines, no frames, no scripts are extracted. The OLE2/CFB container layer is solid (FAT chains, directory, stream extraction); the Flash 8 binary payload parsing was never built. This is an MVP pillar (FLA compatibility) and gates the golden FLA/SWF comparison harness. Scope: reverse-engineer / implement extraction of the Flash 8 'Contents' stream document structure — at minimum: stage properties, scene/timeline/layer/frame structure, shape geometry with fills/strokes, symbol definitions + library, instance placements with matrices, frame scripts (AS2 source). References: the FLA format is partially documented by community efforts (e.g. OpenFLA/libflash research); cross-check anything ambiguous against real fixtures. Acceptance: import a real Flash 8-authored .fla fixture and assert the deserialized document model contains its actual layers/shapes/symbols/scripts (not a skeleton); fixture committed under a fixtures/ dir. Be honest about unsupported corners — partial extraction with explicit warnings beats silent skeletons.

--- CLOSURE EVIDENCE (agent-0697-fable) ---
Implemented: packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts (MFC CArchive parser for CPicPage/CPicLayer/CPicFrame/CPicShape/CPicSprite/CPicButton/CPicText, schema-gated per format version Flash 5-CS4), flash8-import.ts (document-model mapping), ole.ts (mini-FAT + extended DIFAT + stream enumeration; small streams were previously unreadable). Format references: JPEXS flacomdoc (byte-verified FLA writer) + eddiemoore/fla-decoder (Ghidra RE of flash.exe); shape coordinate unit (8.8 fixed-point twips, 1px=5120) verified against SWFs published from the same FLAs.

Fixtures committed: packages/core/fixtures/flash8-nested-textfields.fla (Flash 8-authored, Contents v0x3F) and mx2004-frame-scripts.fla (MX2004 v0x38), provenance ruffle avm1 test corpus (MIT).

Tests: 14 new tests in src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts assert real extracted content — layer names, 3 keyframes with AS2 script source (var x.../delete x;/stop();), library symbols with names+types (button/movieclip), shape geometry matching SWF ground truth (118x74 rect at (60,38), fill #FF3300, 1px black stroke; 480x183 red button shape), symbol instances with placement matrices + instance names (evilbutton, evilmc), dynamic text fields with content/font/size/instance name (eviltext). Legacy ole.test.ts width-heuristic test rewritten to the real Contents encoding (width*20 + zeros + height*20; bg/fps anchor block). Full core suite: 4411 passed. Corpus validation: 152/154 OLE2 .fla in local ruffle clone import with real content, 0 hard failures (2 skeletons are bitmap-only MX files).

NOT imported (console.warn at parse time; honest capability map in flash8-binary.ts header): Media N payloads + bitmap placements, instance/button ActionScript handlers (onClipEvent/on()), filters/blend modes/color effects, shape tween morph data, sound attachments, components/fonts library items, accessibility metadata, Flash 4-and-older frame scripts (compiled action records, not source). Multi-layer page trailers parsed via bounded boundary scan — exact for single-layer fixtures; corpus had no multi-layer pages to verify against.
